answer: Each new agent identity must commit its own proof-of-work nonce, and the ledger rejects any nonce already used, so every Sybil ID burns separate compute instead of sharing one miner's proof. The cost of identity N grows with N, giving an attacker a hard floor: a thousand fake agents cost the energy of a thousand registrations, while an honest agent pays once. Like a crystal grown rather than cloned, each key stays indivisible. With a small locked deposit on top, a dawn wave of bots becomes unprofitable before a fake meadow of accounts can vote.
